subject: User defined prior distribution for parameters

messages.author: ffe734bdfd344422
messages.subject: User defined prior distribution for parameters
parts:
Hi Phil,

it is possible to specify user defined priors for parameters in mirt (others than norm, lnorm and beta, I find in the manual)?

Best,
Alexander

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: User defined prior distribution for parameters
parts:
Hi Alexander,

Currently this is not possible or feasible without a good amount of rewriting, but I'm not opposed to adding more prior functions instead (it's easier to add than customize). Which prior function(s) did you have in mind? Cheers.

Phil

messages.author: 9c889bb0942f49fb
messages.subject: AW: User defined prior distribution for parameters
parts:
Hi Phil,

Maybe inverse gamma; truncated normal distribution; discrete prior distribution (specified for values x1, ...,xK with corresponding probabilities p1, ..., pK).

In any case, defining a discrete (finite) mixture (say of two) of these prior distributions would also be nice.

Best,
Alexander
